name: doc-tools tool smoke
description: Agent smoke cases for six document CLI commands and four specialist Code Plugin tools.

cases.task: Use Bash or PowerShell to run cotree extension run cotree.doc-tools.archive-list with matching --input-json and --workspace on a ZIP-compatible fixture and report the entry names. Follow the existing approval/resume flow if required and verify the returned command status and result.ok.

Use Bash or PowerShell to run cotree extension run cotree.doc-tools.archive-extract with matching --input-json and --workspace on a ZIP-compatible fixture and confirm the selected entries were written inside the requested workspace destination. Follow the existing approval/resume flow if required and verify the returned command status and result.ok.

Use Bash or PowerShell to run cotree extension run cotree.doc-tools.archive-create with matching --input-json and --workspace to package two workspace fixtures and confirm the archive was created. Follow the existing approval/resume flow if required and verify the returned command status and result.ok.

Use Bash or PowerShell to run cotree extension run cotree.doc-tools.docx-read with matching --input-json and --workspace on a DOCX fixture and confirm non-empty text is returned. Follow the existing approval/resume flow if required and verify the returned command status and result.ok.

Use Bash or PowerShell to run cotree extension run cotree.doc-tools.docx-edit with matching --input-json and --workspace to replace known fixture text with backup enabled, then confirm the edit completed. Follow the existing approval/resume flow if required and verify the returned command status and result.ok.

Use Bash or PowerShell to run cotree extension run cotree.doc-tools.office-edit with matching --input-json and --workspace to replace known text in an Office Open XML fixture and confirm the edit completed. Follow the existing approval/resume flow if required and verify the returned command status and result.ok.
Use PluginCoTreeDocToolsOfficeDocumentInspect on an Office fixture and report its format plus extracted text summary.
Use PluginCoTreeDocToolsOfficeDocumentVerify on a fixture with required text and confirm verification passes.
Use PluginCoTreeDocToolsPdfRead on a text PDF fixture and confirm non-empty embedded text is returned.
Use PluginCoTreeDocToolsPdfOcr on a scanned fixture and confirm non-empty recognized text is returned.
